description: This PHP source file defines the CandidateJobOfferingAPI class, which provides an API endpoint to offer a job to a candidate within the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes annotations for API documentation and a method that returns a specific workflow state constant.

classes.name: CandidateJobOfferingAPI
classes.description: A class providing an API endpoint for offering a job to a candidate, including API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getResultingState
methods.description: Returns the workflow state constant indicating the 'offer job' action in the recruitment process.
